eyebrow: SQL:2003 standardized this — and it held
code:
ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SalesPersonID
                    ORDER BY OrderDate DESC)
RANK()       OVER (PARTITION BY SalesPersonID
                    ORDER BY TotalDue DESC)
DENSE_RANK() OVER (...)
caption: Identical function names, identical OVER/PARTITION BY/ORDER BY — everywhere.

code:
SELECT OrderDate, TotalDue,
  LAG(TotalDue)  OVER (ORDER BY OrderDate) AS PrevTotal,
  LEAD(TotalDue) OVER (ORDER BY OrderDate) AS NextTotal,
  SUM(TotalDue)  OVER (ORDER BY OrderDate) AS RunningTotal
FROM Sales.SalesOrderHeader;
caption: Running totals and row-to-row comparisons — same syntax, every dialect.
